whatsappPage.notSubscribed: You are not subscribed to any WhatsApp plan.

whatsappPage.aiAgentDescription: Take your customer interactions to the next level with our AI-powered WhatsApp agent. It can understand and respond to customer inquiries, provide personalized recommendations, and handle complex conversations.

aiFeature1.title: Natural Language Understanding
aiFeature1.description: The AI agent can understand customer messages and respond appropriately.

aiFeature2.title: Personalized Responses
aiFeature2.description: Provide tailored recommendations based on customer preferences and order history.

aiFeature3.title: 24/7 Availability
aiFeature3.description: The AI agent is always available to assist your customers, even outside business hours.

aiFeature4.title: Seamless Integration
aiFeature4.description: Easily integrate the AI agent with your existing WhatsApp Business account.
